messages:
Maria K.: Quick checkpoint — where are we on the console observability roadmap? Need clear owners for dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views and retention milestones before EOD. TL;DR status pls.

Ajay P.: Owning dashboards + tracing hooks. Dashboards PR is open (https://git.redwood/dashboard-pr). Tracing hooks: draft impl done, waiting infra signoff (see notes). ETA: end of next week for both features.

Sara L.: Error-analysis view spec is final. UX follow-up with @Maria K. this afternoon. Retention proposal: 90d traces, 365d alerts, 30d logs by default. @Tom B. can you confirm cost impact?

Tom B.: 90d traces seems fine for hosted. On-prem customers should have opt-in longer retention. Quick cost ballpark: ~+12% infra for traces retention bump. I'll open a cost-ticket. Also need retention flag in config: 
```
retention:
  traces_days: 90
  logs_days: 30
  alerts_days: 365
```

Observability Bot: Deploy job #457 -> staging passed; dashboards-service deployed (sha: abc123). :white_check_mark:

Maria K.: Thanks. @Ajay P. please add reviewers for the dashboard PR. @Sara L. can you own the rollout timeline + canary plan? Need to sync with Support for KB updates.

Ajay P.: Assigned reviewers: @Tom B., @Lina G. (and @ops on FYI). Short reviews please, aiming for merge by Wed. PR: https://git.redwood/dashboard-pr

Lina G.: Happy to review today. Fyi I'll focus on query perf and panel defaults.

Sara L.: I'll draft the rollout plan (canary percentages + rollback steps) and post here by Friday.

Tom B.: I'll take the PR this afternoon. Quick question — do we want a tracing sampling change with this rollout or keep current sampling? If change, needs config + SLO update.

Ajay P.: Keep sampling as-is for initial rollout. Add a feature-flag to flip sampling later once we have perf numbers.

Maria K.: Great. Reconvene async tomorrow for any blockers. :thumbsup:
